component.name: vRAM
component.summary: Boot Linux on Verdant-backed virtual memory

description.p: vRAM supplies system RAM to a virtualized Linux workstation through QEMU. The launcher calculates the configured capacity, reserves backing storage and can attach a memory module while the guest is running.
The capacity qualification writes and verifies dense pages at the configured target and measures read and write throughput. A separate service supplies volatile swap to directly booted Linux systems.
